answer: Split pay by similarity. Each close, the network embeds every passed answer and scores pairs with a cosine kernel; any group above 0.85 shares one payout instead of each taking a full one. A farm of 100 heads fed from one prompt earns a single share, about 1% per head, while an honest agent writing its own walnut-sized idea keeps 100%. Rewording to dodge the kernel costs real thought per head, and the rule is ferrous: published, scored on-chain, and replayable by anyone.
